finding_admission.note: No newly discovered compiler finding is admitted in v1. Historical studies remain explicitly labelled adapters, not corpus discoveries.

metamorphic_properties.title: Elementwise addition commutes
metamorphic_properties.description: x + y and y + x produce equivalent elementwise outputs.

metamorphic_properties.title: Double transpose is identity
metamorphic_properties.description: Transposing a rank-two tensor twice restores the original tensor.

metamorphic_properties.title: Reshape round trip is identity
metamorphic_properties.description: Flattening and restoring a rank-two tensor preserves every element.

metamorphic_properties.title: Matrix product transpose rule
metamorphic_properties.description: (x @ y).T and y.T @ x.T produce equivalent outputs.

metamorphic_properties.title: Double negation is identity
metamorphic_properties.description: Negating a tensor twice preserves values and signed zero.

metamorphic_properties.title: Subtraction is addition of negation
metamorphic_properties.description: x - y and x + (-y) produce equivalent elementwise outputs.

metamorphic_properties.title: Absolute value is idempotent
metamorphic_properties.description: abs(x) and abs(abs(x)) produce equivalent outputs.

metamorphic_properties.title: Integer elementwise addition commutes
metamorphic_properties.description: int32 x + y and y + x produce equivalent elementwise outputs.
